alternative_results.name: mean_of_aliquot_proportions
alternative_results.reason: Averaging aliquot relative abundances per core is also a defensible core-level pooling.

sufficiency_witness: Several cores were split and processed under two or three laboratory numbers; the splits are subsamples of one core at one site, so the core is the sampling unit and its splits are pooled. Treating splits as units inflates n.
analysis_specification: Map each lab_number to its core via register.csv and sum the counts of a core's lab numbers. Convert each core to relative abundances and run one-way PERMANOVA (Bray–Curtis) with zone as the factor, cores as units; report pseudo-F, R² and n.
